QuestInfo.name: [Red Leaf High] Chapter 6: Pied Piper in the Custodial Closet
QuestInfo.1: The Pied Piper Cat ghost released some rats in the Custodial Closet. Go to there and stop the mice and the Piper from eating up all the food.
QuestInfo.2: The Pied Piper Cat ghost released some rats in the Custodial Closet. You went there and stopped the mice and the Piper from eating up all the food.
QuestInfo.parent: [Red Leaf High] Ghost of Red Leaf High

0.0: Ahhhh! Have you been to the Custodial Closet? It's overrun with MICE. Students say that a cat ghost called #bPied Piper Cat#k is playing a flute to control the mice. How is one supposed to carry out cooking lessons if the classroom is overrun with MICE!? Can you go to the Custodial Closet and rout out the mice and the cat?

yes.0: The Pied Piper Cat should appear if you go to the Custodial Closet and start routing the mice out. You must also rout out the cat! But watch out for the ghosts there, each of their hits will damage you for 20% of your health. Ghosts can't look below so you can stay low to avoid getting hit.
yes.1: Don't even think about eating or drinking things like potions and food. The headmaster strictly forbade such in the Custodial Closet. #rBut you can eat the food in the pot there.#k The rule was originally put in place since students kept eating in the class, but so much for that.\r\n#b#eDoor on your right#k#n will take you to the Custodial Closet.

no.0: I wanted to do my chocolate brownies lesson tomrrow but how am I supposed to teach at this state!?
